take: Detroit announced it has placed forward Dylan Larkin on the non-roster injured reserve. Larkin has played 6 games this season with 1 goal and 3 points, after scoring 34 goals last year, and he averages 21.81 minutes a night. Going by how the coach has used his players, Viktor Arvidsson (19:15 a night) is next in line for those minutes, and Michael Rasmussen, the busiest man on the second power-play unit, is the likeliest to move up. Detroit is 3-3-2 and has generated about half the expected goals so far (49.8%).
